purpose: GPT-researched learning units routed through versioned GitHub into Grok review; not market claims or production rule authorization.

levels.name: 专业机制
levels.goal: Wallet, funding, market and causal alternatives.

levels.name: 研究方法
levels.goal: Falsification, predictive baselines, OOS and execution economics.

levels.name: Skill应用
levels.goal: Reproducible real read-only task, tool errors, expert replay and feedback.

units.title: F0–F6 证据过滤的专业理解
review_questions: 同源资金还缺真实交易时，为什么 F2 不通过且 F3 只能保留假设？
F4 上涨预测能力为何不能代替 F5 净可执行盈利？
event_at 早于 decision_at 但 available_at 晚于 decision_at 的数据能否作为交易特征？
解释任务是否需要 F5，监控发布是否需要人工批准？
success_conditions: Correctly distinguishes NOT_EVALUATED, INSUFFICIENT, REJECTED, NOT_APPLICABLE and evidence-backed PASS.
Can state a falsifiable mechanism plus at least one benign explanation.
Does not treat documents or fixture as real chain evidence or gate-pass proof.
units.notes: Draft educational content linked to existing F0–F6 policy; not independently signed off or installed in Grok.

units.title: 钱包资金关联与群组的专业证据边界
review_questions: Why is a funding edge neither common beneficial owner nor executable trading alpha?
How do CEX hubs and shared execution services become negative controls?
Why can operator recurrence be predictive unconditionally yet add no incremental information after matching?
success_conditions: Correctly distinguishes structural evidence, conditional increment and net profitability.
Preserves as-of time of any evidence and gives explicit alternative mechanisms.
Reports source-derived numbers as external claims, not independent local replication.
units.notes: Draft C2 expert lesson based on proposed method and reported third-party results.

units.title: AS-OF 可得时间、预测增量与净可交易性实验
review_questions: Why is historical blockTime insufficient to prove real-time feature observability?
How should operator-linked OOS, non-alert denominators, route availability and fees be assessed?
Why does a valid paper quote fail to prove a real executable fill?
success_conditions: Distinguishes synthetic offline time validators from market evidence.
Defines preregistered target, baseline, group/time OOS, cost and tail loss.
Never promotes unreviewed candidate hypotheses into B07 release.
units.notes: Advanced methodology only; stages 1–5 have not been run on real market data.
